Expected status: correct_terminal_live
Issue feedback: {"evidence": "The gate applicability is disputed and must not be overridden by Audit wording.", "issue_type": "gate_false_positive", "owner": "gate"}

Return exactly these fields:
{
  "route": string,
  "target_stage": string,
  "resolution_status": string,
  "action_summary": string,
  "should_continue_pipeline": boolean,
  "should_ask_user": boolean,
